id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Point-to-point single-twisted-pair full-duplex link (100BASE-T1 / 1000BASE-T1 / 10BASE-T1L): one master PHY + one slave PHY per link, echo-cancelled bidirectional on the one pair. PLUS a MULTIDROP 'mixing segment' for 10BASE-T1S where several PHYs share one short single-pair bus and use PLCA (node 0 = coordinator) to take deterministic round-robin transmit opportunities.

supported_topologies.name: Multidrop mixing segment (PLCA)
supported_topologies.description: 10BASE-T1S; several PHYs share one short single-pair segment, arbitrated by PLCA.

supported_topologies.name: AVB / TSN overlay
supported_topologies.description: Time-sensitive audio/video + control traffic layered on the single-pair PHY.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Sources the symbol clock; one end of each link.
Loop-times (recovers clock) from the master; the other end.
10BASE-T1S multidrop: emits the beacon, starts each PLCA cycle.
MDC/MDIO master configuring master/slave, PLCA, EEE; reading SNR/MSE.

fields.interconnect_role: The single MDI pair is point-to-point for the full-duplex variants and a shared bus for the 10BASE-T1S multidrop segment. The MDC/MDIO management bus is a separate shared bus addressed by PRTAD.

ordering_guarantees.in_link_ordering: MAC delivers received frames in order.
ordering_guarantees.multidrop_access: PLCA serialises access deterministically in node-ID order (no CSMA/CD).

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: No MAC-layer address space. PHY management is the MDC/MDIO register space (Clause 22 basic + Clause 45 MMD), including master/slave, SNR/MSE, PLCA, and EEE registers. PHY identity is in the standard PHY-ID registers.

device_classification.automotive_phy: 100BASE-T1 / 1000BASE-T1 single-pair PHY for in-vehicle sensor/display/backbone links.
device_classification.multidrop_node: 10BASE-T1S PHY with a PLCA node ID on a shared segment.
device_classification.long_reach_phy: 10BASE-T1L single-pair PHY for process-automation field instruments (up to 1000 m).
device_classification.switch_bridge: Automotive Ethernet switch with multiple single-pair ports + AVB/TSN.
